verses.1:
For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song.
 May God be gracious to us and bless us,
 and cause His face to shine upon us,
 Selah
verses.2:
that Your ways may be known on earth,
 Your salvation among all nations.
verses.3:
Let the peoples praise You, O God;
 let all the peoples praise You.
verses.4:
Let the nations be glad and sing for joy,
 for You judge the peoples justly
 and lead the nations of the earth.
 Selah
verses.5:
Let the peoples praise You, O God;
 let all the peoples praise You.
verses.6:
The earth has yielded its harvest;
 God, our God, blesses us.
verses.7:
God blesses us,
 that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.

metadata.source: Derived from the Berean Standard Bible (BSB). Missing verses restored from the Textus Receptus tradition for completeness.
